description: Export the Field Recorder EU AI Act Article 12 record-keeping report for a date range — the signed, hash-chained evidence of what deployed models did on-device (clause 12(1)/12(2)(a)/12(2)(b)/integrity mapping, event summary, Ed25519 signature). Verification evidence, NOT a compliance certification. The formatted assessor PDF is on the Field Recorder dashboard page.

device_id.description: Optional — restrict the report to a single device.

from.description: Start of the reporting period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-06-01).

to.description: End of the reporting period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-07-01).

name: edgegate_export_field_recorder_report
